failure.title: Performance corpus evaluation name violated the strict gate-result contract
failure.note: The complete database gate report retains 25 HTTP 500 validation failures in each 100-request run, all for programme 54000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000112, while the redacted container log records the matching sanitized ZodError request IDs.
failure.diagnosis: The direct-SQL standard corpus inserted evaluation name performance_corpus_gate, which is not a member of gateResultSchema's closed name enum. Programme-detail output parsing therefore failed closed with HTTP 500 whenever the critical route read that evaluation.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
